neighbours.label: a marker of an anticipated future event ('the coin will', French 'prévus pour', 'scheduled to'): stating what is expected to happen, versus the same events reported as past
fire: I bet that the dice will show a six on the next roll.
She is sure that the team will win the cup this season.
Des ateliers sont prévus pour les familles pendant le week-end.
Plusieurs concerts sont prévus pour l'été prochain dans le parc.
My guess is that the price will drop after the holidays.
Everyone knows there will be trouble if the river keeps rising.
Analysts predict that interest rates will fall next year.
Le match est prévu pour samedi soir au stade municipal.
quiet: I saw that the dice showed a six on the last roll.
She was sure that the team had won the cup last season.
Des ateliers ont eu lieu avec les familles pendant le week-end.
Plusieurs concerts ont eu lieu l'été dernier dans le parc.
My guess was right: the price dropped after the holidays.
Everyone knew there was trouble when the river kept rising.
Analysts noted that interest rates fell last year.
Le match a eu lieu samedi soir au stade municipal.

predictions: fire 0.2-0.6 on ' will' / 'prévus pour'; past-tense versions below 0.06
notes: Card: ' will', ' pour', ' soll', 'expected to', 'scheduled to be', 'guaranteed to'. Probe: 'sont prévus pour' 0.673, 'the coin will land' 0.528, 'scheduled to begin at eight,' 0.336, 'the storm will reach' 0.191, 'expected to open' 0.129; past versions 0.035-0.044. Weak for plain forecasts; strongest after a bet or plan.
